The '''NA LCS 2017 Spring Split''' was the first split of the 2017 [[North American League of Legends Championship Series]] (NA LCS) season, organized by Riot Games and held from January 20 to April 23, 2017. Ten teams competed in a Double Round Robin Group Stage with Best-of-Three matches, followed by a Single Elimination Best-of-Five Playoffs. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, while the bottom two were relegated to the [[LCS/North America/2017/Summer/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]]. The winner qualified for the [[Mid-Season Invitational/2017|2017 Mid-Season Invitational]] and earned 90 Championship Points toward Worlds qualification.

The split featured newcomers as [[FlyQuest]] acquired the roster of [[Cloud9 Challenger]], while [[Echo Fox]] and [[Phoenix1]] requalified the league through the [[LCS/North America/2017/Spring/Promotion|2017 Spring Promotion Tournament]], while [[Team Dignitas]] rejoined the league after acquiring the [[Apex Gaming]] slot. The Regular Season was hosted at the Riot Games Studio in Los Angeles, with the Finals held in Vancouver, Canada. The total prize pool was $200,000, and the competition was played on Patch 7.6.

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd till 6th place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''7th and 8th place''}} qualify for Summer split.
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} relegate to the Promotion Tournament.
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
* Winner Qualifies for [[Mid-Season Invitational/2017|2017 Mid-Season Invitational]]
